text: ServiceNow's 2026 proxy statement lists its only shareholders above 5% as BlackRock, Inc. (8.8%) and The Vanguard Group, Inc. (8.7%); the rest is widely held.
short: ServiceNow is a listed US company; BlackRock 8.8% and Vanguard 8.7% are its largest holders.
